dashboard: Start with the dashboard: it shows where your job search needs focus today.
Check upcoming interviews and tasks before browsing new vacancies.
If metrics are flat, update application statuses and add recent outreach.
vacancies: Add only vacancies you are ready to revisit in the next few days.
Keep the vacancy description filled in so AI can evaluate the match more accurately.
Save the original posting link to get back to details quickly.
applications: Move applications between statuses right after each company interaction.
Mark interviews separately so analytics stays useful.
Do not keep stale applications in active statuses if there has been no response.
tasks: Link tasks to specific applications to maintain context.
Sort by deadline: overdue and nearest tasks first.
Mark completed tasks to keep the list current.
interviews: Schedule interviews in advance so you can prepare better.
Add notes after each interview for future preparation.
Track results to understand your strengths and weaknesses.
companies: Add company notes so you can compare context, not only vacancy titles.
Save company industry and location to filter opportunities more easily.
Before applying, check whether the company already has related vacancies.
aiAssistant: Add more context before generation — AI output becomes noticeably more precise.
Use AI for a first draft, then adapt the final text to your own voice.
For interview prep, analyze the vacancy first and generate questions after that.
analytics: Look at trends, not just totals: trends show progress more clearly.
If interviews are low, review vacancy quality and resume fit.
Skill gaps help you decide what to improve first.
settings: Keep your profile up to date: these details support your workspace.
Check the interface language before presenting the project.
Notification settings help you avoid missing important search stages.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: CareerPilot AI ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information when you use our job search management platform at {{url}}.

items.account: Account information: email address, name, and password (stored as a secure hash).
items.jobSearch: Job search data: vacancies, applications, interviews, companies, and tasks you create within the app.
items.oauth: OAuth credentials: when you sign in via Google or GitHub, we receive your public profile and email only.
items.googleCalendar: Google Calendar tokens: if you connect Google Calendar, we store a refresh token to create interview events on your behalf. We only use the {{scope}} scope.
items.usage: Usage data: technical logs such as timestamps and error reports, used solely for debugging.

howWeUseInformation.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
items: To provide and operate the CareerPilot AI service.
To create Google Calendar events for your scheduled interviews (only when you explicitly connect your calendar).
To send transactional emails (e.g., password reset, email verification).
To improve the application based on aggregated, anonymised usage patterns.
howWeUseInformation.note: We do {{not}} sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.

googleApiServices.title: 4. Google API Services
googleApiServices.content: CareerPilot AI's use of information received from Google APIs adheres to the {{policy}}, including the Limited Use requirements.
googleApiServices.specific: Specifically, the Google Calendar refresh token stored for your account is used exclusively to create, update, or delete calendar events related to your interviews within CareerPilot AI. This data is not transferred to any third party or used for any other purpose.
googleApiServices.disconnect: You can disconnect Google Calendar at any time from {{settings}}, which immediately deletes your stored token.

dataStorageAndSecurity.title: 5. Data Storage and Security
dataStorageAndSecurity.content: Your data is stored in a PostgreSQL database hosted on Google Cloud (Europe region). Sensitive values such as API keys and OAuth tokens are encrypted at rest using AES encryption. We apply industry-standard security practices including HTTPS-only transport and JWT-based authentication.

dataRetention.title: 6. Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We retain your data for as long as your account is active. You may request deletion of your account and all associated data at any time by contacting us at the email below. Upon deletion, all personal data is permanently removed within 30 days.

yourRights.title: 7. Your Rights
items: Access or export your personal data.
Request deletion of your account and data.
Revoke Google Calendar access at any time via the app or your Google Account settings.

changesToPolicy.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
changesToPolicy.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes by updating the date at the top of this page.

contact.title: 9. Contact
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at: {{email}}
